profile.name: Cobolt激光器
profile.description: Cobolt激光器是一种实验室激光光源，常用于光学搭建、样品激发、光路对准及其他需要稳定激光输出的实验。该类设备通常可通过串口通信进行控制与状态交互。
profile.description_en: A Cobolt laser source is a laboratory laser used for optical setups, sample excitation, beam alignment, and other experiments that require stable laser output. This type of device is commonly controlled and queried through a serial communication interface.
